WITH account_shares AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count,
        1.0 * COUNT(o.order_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "order") AS share
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM account_shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(s.order_count) AS total_orders,
    AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
    AVG(s.share) - a.share AS average_excess
FROM account_shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE s.share > a.share

WITH account_orders AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM "order"
    GROUP BY account_id
),
shares AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        order_count,
        1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM account_orders
),
average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(s.order_count) AS total_orders,
    AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
    AVG(s.share) - a.share AS average_excess
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE s.share > a.share

WITH account_orders AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
),
shares AS (
    SELECT order_count,
           1.0 * order_count / NULLIF(SUM(order_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
    FROM account_orders
),
compared AS (
    SELECT order_count,
           share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_orders,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(100.0 * (share - average_share) / average_share) AS mean_excess_percent
FROM compared
WHERE share > average_share
